सम्हालेपछिको आफ्नो पहिलो द्विपक्षीय भारत भ्रमणका क्रममा भारतीय समकक्षी नरेन्द्र मोदीसँगको संयुक्त पत्रकार सम्मेलनमा उनले दुई देशबीचको आत्मीयतालाई शब्दमा व्यक्त गर्न कठिन हुने टिप्पणी गरे । प्रधानमन्त्री शाहले भगवान् श्री पशुपतिनाथ, माता जानकी र करुणामय मच्छिन्द्रनाथको आशीर्वाद तथा नेपाली जनताको स्नेह, न्यानोपन र सद्भाव लिएर आफू भारत भ्रमणमा आएको बताए । हार्दिक निमन्त्रणा र न्यानो आतिथ्यताका लागि भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री मोदीप्रति आभार व्यक्त गर्दै उनले पारस्परिक सम्मान, अटल विश्वास र अटुट सद्भाव नै नेपाल–भारत सम्बन्धको मूल आधारशिला भएको र यस सम्बन्धको केन्द्रमा दुई देशका जनता रहेको धारणा राखे । शताब्दीयौँ पुरानो ऐतिहासिक सम्बन्धलाई थप सुदृढ र समयसापेक्ष बनाउने लक्ष्यका साथ सम्पन्न प्रतिनिधिमण्डलस्तरीय वार्तामा बहुआयामिक द्विपक्षीय साझेदारीका विषयमा खुलस्त, सार्थक र दूरगामी छलफल भएको प्रधानमन्त्री शाहले जानकारी दिए । सो क्रममा नेपालमा आईआईटी स्थापना गर्ने तथा दुई देशका सहरहरूबीच सिधा हवाई सम्पर्क (डाइरेक्ट एयर कनेक्टिभिटी) विस्तार गर्ने विषयमा समेत सहमति जुटेको उनले बताए । प्रधानमन्त्री शाहले सम्पूर्ण नेपाली जनताको तर्फबाट भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीलाई नेपाल भ्रमणका लागि हार्दिक निमन्त्रणा दिएका छन् । उनले भारतका जनतालाई नेपालमा रहेका आस्थाका केन्द्रहरू- भगवान् पशुपतिनाथ, माता जानकी, जीवित देवी कुमारी तथा शान्तिका अग्रदूत भगवान् गौतम बुद्धको जन्मस्थल लुम्बिनी भ्रमणका लागि निमन्त्रणा गरे । शाहको सम्बोधनको पूर्णपाठ : भगवान् श्री पशुपतिनाथ, माता जानकी तथा करुणामय मच्छिन्द्रनाथको आशीर्वाद, नेपाली जनताको प्रेम स्नेह र सद्भाव लिएर भारतको राजकीय भ्रमणमा आएको छु । हार्दिक निमन्त्रणा, न्यानो आतिथ्यताका लागि म महामहिम प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीप्रति हार्दिक आभार प्रकट गर्दछु । पारस्परिक सम्मान, अटल विश्वास र अविच्छिन्न सद्भाव नेपाल-भारत सम्बन्धको मूल आधारशिला हो । अतुलनीय यस सम्बन्धको केन्द्र हाम्रो दुई देशका जनता रहेका छन् । नेपाल र भारत बीचको सम्बन्ध हिमाल झैँ अटल, महासागर झैँ विशाल छ । यो यस्तो आत्मीय निकटता हो जसलाई शब्दको सीमिततामा बाँध्न सकिन्न । एक विश्वासनीय छिमेकीका रूपमा नेपालमा प्राकृतिक प्रकोप र विपद्‌का कठिन घडीमा अग्रपङ्क्तिमा रहेर सहयोग गर्दै आएको छ । म भारत सरकार र भारतीय जनताप्रति कृतज्ञता व्यक्त गर्दछु । भर्खरै हाम्रो प्रतिनिधिमण्डलस्तरीय वर्ता सम्पन्न भएको छ । शताब्दीयौँ पुरानो ऐतिहासिक सम्बन्धलाई अझ सुदृढ र युग सापेक्ष बनाउने उद्देश्यसहित हामीले दुई पक्षीय सम्बन्धका बहुआयामिक पक्षबाट सार्थक र दूरगामी छलफल गरेका छौँ । यस क्रममा नेपाल-भारत सहकार्यका विविध क्षेत्रमा महत्त्वपूर्ण साझेदरी तथा परियोजनाको उद्घाटन एवं शिलान्यास समेत सम्पन्न भएका छन् । हामीले आज गरेका समझदारीहरू र अघि बढाइएका परियोजनाहरूको प्रतिफल समृद्धिका रूपमा देखिनुपर्छ । यी ऐतिहासिक उपलब्धिहरूले हाम्रो दुई मुलुकको समृद्ध भविष्यका लिग मिलेर काम गर्न हामीले जोइन्ट भिजन डकुमेन्ट एवं हाम्रा साझा उपलब्धिहरूको संयुक्त प्रेस रिलिजमार्फत जानकारी गराइने छ । यस महत्त्वपूर्ण अवसरमा महामहिम नरेन्द्र मोदीज्यूलाई सम्पूर्ण नेपाली जनताको तर्फबाट नेपाल शान्तिका अग्रदूत भगवान् गौतम बुद्धको जन्मस्थल नेपालको भ्रमणका लागि हार्दिक निमन्त्रणा गर्न चाहन्छु । नेपाल र भारत बीचको मित्रता यस्तो होस् जहाँ विश्वास हिमालझैँ होस्, सहकार्य नदी झैँ अविरल बगोस् र दुवै राष्ट्रको समृद्धि हाम्रो साझा आकाश मुनि फक्रियोस् । हामी सबैको जय होस । Kathmandu. Prime Minister Balendra Shah, who is on a state visit to India, has said that the relationship between Nepal and India is as unwavering as the mountains and as vast as the ocean. During his first bilateral visit to India after assuming office as Prime Minister, he remarked at a joint press conference with his Indian counterpart Narendra Modi that it was difficult to express in words the closeness between the two countries. Prime Minister Shah said that he had come to India with the blessings of Lord Pashupatinath, Mata Janaki and Karunamay Machhindranath and the affection, warmth and goodwill of the Nepali people. Expressing gratitude to Indian Prime Minister Modi for the cordial invitation and warm hospitality, he opined that mutual respect, unwavering trust and unwavering goodwill are the cornerstones of Nepal-India relations and that the people of the two countries are at the center of this relationship. Prime Minister Shah informed that the delegation-level talks, held with the aim of further strengthening and modernizing the centuries-old historical relations, held open, meaningful and far-reaching discussions on multi-faceted bilateral partnership. He said that during the talks, an agreement was also reached on establishing an IIT in Nepal and expanding direct air connectivity between the cities of the two countries. Prime Minister Shah has extended a heartfelt invitation to Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to visit Nepal on behalf of the entire Nepali people. He invited the people of India to visit the centers of faith in Nepal - Lord Pashupatinath, Mother Janaki, the living Goddess Kumari, and Lumbini, the birthplace of Lord Gautam Buddha, the messenger of peace. Full text of Shah's address: I have come on a state visit to India with the blessings of Lord Pashupatinath, Mother Janaki and compassionate Machhindranath, and the love, affection and goodwill of the Nepali people. I express my heartfelt gratitude to His Excellency Prime Minister Narendra Modi for the cordial invitation and warm hospitality. Mutual respect, unwavering trust and unwavering goodwill are the cornerstones of Nepal-India relations. At the heart of this unparalleled relationship are the people of our two countries. The relationship between Nepal and India is as unwavering as the mountains, as vast as the ocean. It is a closeness that cannot be confined within the confines of words. As a trusted neighbor, India has been at the forefront of Nepal's efforts to help during difficult times of natural disasters and calamities. I express my gratitude to the Government and people of India. Our delegation-level talks have just concluded. With the aim of further strengthening the centuries-old historical relations and making them relevant to the times, we have had meaningful and far-reaching discussions on the multifaceted aspects of bilateral relations. During this process, important partnerships and projects in various areas of Nepal-India cooperation have also been inaugurated and laid. The agreements we have made today and the projects we have undertaken should bear fruit in prosperity. These historic achievements will help us work together to build a prosperous future for our two countries, as we will communicate our shared achievements through a joint vision document and a joint press release. On this important occasion, I would like to extend a heartfelt invitation to His Excellency Narendra Modi to visit Nepal on behalf of all the Nepali people. I would also like to extend a heartfelt invitation to the friendly people of India to visit Nepal, the birthplace of Muktinath Lord Shri Pashupatinath located in the lap of the Himalayas, [Mata Janaki, the living goddess Kumari, and the forerunner of peace, Lord Gautam Buddha. May the friendship between Nepal and India be such that trust is like a mountain, cooperation flows like a river, and the prosperity of both nations flourish under our common sky. May we all prosper.
